instance_id: <str> Unique identifier for this problem instance.
scale: <str> Size category of the instance (small, medium, or large).

stress_parameters.eta_p: <float> Multiplier applied to base electricity demand across all buses.
stress_parameters.eta_g: <float> Multiplier applied to base gas demand across all junctions.

time_periods: <int> Number of time periods in the planning horizon.

electricity_network.num_buses: <int> Number of buses in the electricity transmission grid.
electricity_network.num_lines: <int> Number of transmission lines connecting buses.

buses.demand_profile: <list[float], length time_periods> Electricity demand at this bus in each time period (MW).
buses.voltage_angle_lb: <float> Lower bound on the voltage phase angle at this bus (radians).
buses.voltage_angle_ub: <float> Upper bound on the voltage phase angle at this bus (radians).

lines.id: <int> Unique identifier for this transmission line.
lines.from_bus: <int> Bus at one endpoint of the line.
lines.to_bus: <int> Bus at the other endpoint of the line.
lines.susceptance: <float> Electrical susceptance of the line relating power flow to voltage angle difference (MW/rad).
lines.thermal_limit: <float> Maximum allowable power flow on the line (MW).
lines.angle_diff_limit: <float> Maximum allowable voltage angle difference between the two endpoint buses (radians).

generators.num_generators: <int> Total number of generators in the system.
generators.num_gfpp: <int> Number of gas-fired power plants among the generators.

generators.bus: <int> Bus where this generator is located.
generators.is_gfpp: <bool> Whether this generator is a gas-fired power plant that consumes natural gas.
generators.gas_junction: <int or null> Gas network junction from which this GFPP draws fuel, or null for non-GFPP generators.
generators.min_power: <float> Minimum real power output when the generator is on (MW).
generators.ramp_down: <float> Maximum decrease in power output between consecutive time periods (MW).
generators.ramp_up: <float> Maximum increase in power output between consecutive time periods (MW).
generators.no_load_cost: <float> Fixed operating cost incurred each period the generator is on ($).
generators.min_up_time: <int> Minimum number of consecutive periods the generator must remain on after starting up.
generators.min_down_time: <int> Minimum number of consecutive periods the generator must remain off after shutting down.
generators.initial_status: <int> On/off status of the generator at the start of the horizon (1 = on, 0 = off).
generators.initial_gen: <float> Power output of the generator in the pre-horizon period (MW).
generators.initial_active_periods: <int> Number of consecutive periods the generator has been on at the start of the horizon.
generators.initial_inactive_periods: <int> Number of consecutive periods the generator has been off at the start of the horizon.
generators.startup_cost_params: <list[list[float]], length min_up_time> Startup cost tiers, each a pair of lookback window length (periods) and associated startup cost ($).
generators.num_bids: <int> Number of supply bid segments for this generator.

bids.id: <int> Unique identifier for this bid segment.
bids.price: <float> Marginal price of electricity offered in this bid segment ($/MWh).
bids.max_amount: <float> Maximum generation quantity available in this bid segment (MW).

heat_rate_coefficients.H_u2: <float or null> Quadratic coefficient of the heat rate curve relating power output to gas consumption (mmBtu/MW^2h).
heat_rate_coefficients.H_u1: <float or null> Linear coefficient of the heat rate curve (mmBtu/MWh).
heat_rate_coefficients.H_u0: <float or null> Constant coefficient of the heat rate curve (mmBtu/h).

generators.max_gas_price_fraction: <float or null> Maximum fraction of the global gas price upper bound at which this GFPP's bids remain profitable, or null for non-GFPP generators.

gas_network.num_junctions: <int> Number of junctions in the gas transmission network.
gas_network.num_connections: <int> Total number of connections (pipelines and compressors) in the gas network.
gas_network.num_compressors: <int> Number of compressor connections in the gas network.
gas_network.num_pricing_zones: <int> Number of gas pricing zones partitioning the junctions.
gas_network.max_gas_price_mmBtu: <float> Global upper bound on the gas price ($/mmBtu).
gas_network.min_gas_price_mmBtu: <float> Global lower bound on the gas price ($/mmBtu).

pricing_zones.id: <int> Unique identifier for this pricing zone.
pricing_zones.junctions: <list[int]> Gas junctions belonging to this pricing zone.

junctions.id: <int> Unique identifier for this gas junction.
junctions.is_source: <bool> Whether this junction is a gas supply source.
junctions.pressure_lb_squared: <float> Lower bound on the squared pressure at this junction.
junctions.pressure_ub_squared: <float> Upper bound on the squared pressure at this junction.
junctions.demand_shedding_cost: <float> Penalty cost per unit of unmet gas demand at this junction ($/unit).
junctions.gas_demand_profile: <list[float], length time_periods> Exogenous gas demand at this junction in each time period.

supply_intervals.id: <int> Unique identifier for this supply interval.
supply_intervals.interval_lb: <float> Lower bound on gas production in this interval.
supply_intervals.interval_ub: <float> Upper bound on gas production in this interval.
supply_intervals.slope: <float> Marginal cost of gas supply within this interval ($/unit).

connections.id: <int> Unique identifier for this gas network connection.
connections.from_junction: <int> Junction at the upstream end of the connection.
connections.to_junction: <int> Junction at the downstream end of the connection.
connections.weymouth_factor: <float or null> Resistance factor relating pressure drop to squared gas flow for pipelines, or null for compressors.
connections.compression_ratio_lb: <float or null> Lower bound on the pressure compression ratio for compressors, or null for pipelines.
connections.compression_ratio_ub: <float or null> Upper bound on the pressure compression ratio for compressors, or null for pipelines.
connections.control_ratio_lb: <float or null> Lower bound on the control valve ratio, or null if not applicable.
connections.control_ratio_ub: <float or null> Upper bound on the control valve ratio, or null if not applicable.
